description:
Pattern β: value-type tightening on already-β-shaped field.

File: crate-jmap-tasks-types/src/task.rs:323

  // Before
  pub recurrence_overrides: Option<HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>>,
  // After
  pub recurrence_overrides: Option<HashMap<String, jmap_types::PatchObject>>,

Doc-comment already says 'Map of LocalDateTime → PatchObject for per-instance overrides.' (PLAN.md confirms.)

Wire format unchanged (PatchObject is #[serde(transparent)]). Public API change: any caller pattern-matching on the inner Value type or constructing the field with serde_json::json!({...}) values must migrate to PatchObject::from_map(...).

## Scope

- 1 line change + import in tasks-types.
- Verify no consumer code in tasks-server / tasks-client constructs this field via struct literal (round-trip deserialization is transparent).
- PLAN.md: update §X row referencing this field to cite the typed shape.

## Acceptance criteria

cargo test --workspace clean, lib clippy clean, wire format byte-identical.
title: Migrate Task::recurrence_overrides value type to PatchObject (β, shape preserved)
